title: aniflow selective frame repair configuration v1
description: Explicit caller settings for fresh immutable import followed by serial direct-image repair. The caller trusts a self-contained executable or wrapper; profile and version are declarations, executable bytes are pinned, and external model/environment identity is unobserved. No download, discovery, native qualification or OS sandbox is implied. Rust additionally enforces UTF-8 byte bounds and aggregate admission arithmetic.

maximum_working_bytes.description: Aggregate working-data admission budget. This is not a filesystem reservation, process memory limit or sandbox. Independent outer runtime artifact limits still apply.

arguments.description: Literal argv, with {input} and {output} each occupying exactly one complete argument exactly once. No shell expansion. Rust limits each argument to 4096 UTF-8 bytes and the combined arguments to 32768 UTF-8 bytes; schema string length alone cannot establish those byte limits. Other brace expressions and control characters are refused.
